hypothesis: The five reviewed live combos pinned on 2026-08-26 have positive net out-of-sample economics under the costs live adoption applies.

protocol.decisionScope: Phase retrospective can only REJECT or be INCONCLUSIVE; it can never PASS or authorize anything. Phase prospective is the only path to a PASS claim, and even a PASS grants no promotion, sizing change or live authorization (human review required).
priorEvidenceDisclosure: Stored optimizer metrics for the five combos (Sharpe 6.9-13.6 on the optimizer's own last-20% slice) were seen; those slices also ranked/selected the combos and are not out-of-sample evidence.
The ADA combo's operational live record (metrics_json.live, 22 operations, 2026-07-21..2026-09-20) was seen; ADA is excluded from both phases.

Mechanics were validated by a full dry run on 2026-02-16..2026-03-23 (strictly before createdAtMs, i.e. inside the optimizer's own selection period; not evidence). The dry run showed the adopted UNI and ETC configurations made zero round trips there, which led to the explicit no_trades reason; no rule depends on evaluation-window rows.

Process incident (2026-10-09, before this registration was committed): a harness dry run meant for a pre-creation window ran on the real retrospective window because load_registration's default argument was bound at import time. It was killed during UNIUSDT seed 2; it wrote no results or return files and printed only per-seed bar counts (1183). No return, equity, PnL or statistic from any evaluation-window row was observed. The bug was fixed before this registration was committed.
protocol.adoptionCapNote: Live runs with TRADER_BOT_START_ADOPTION_MAX_POSITION_SIZE_CAP=0.01. With proportional costs and no fixed fee the sign of net return is invariant to size, so the screen evaluates at each combo's native adopted size; drawdown is therefore the native-size drawdown (stricter than live).
protocol.replay: For each consecutive chunk of chunkBars bars in the window, run trader-hs --adopt-combo-file/--adopt-combo-uuid (live adoption path: venue cost floors, adoption caps) on the combo's own windowBars rows ending at the chunk end; the backtest slice is the chunk plus one leading anchor bar. The model is refit per chunk on strictly earlier rows; parameters never change. Per-bar net returns are chained across chunks; each chunk starts flat.
protocol.baselines: On identical rows and identical adopted per-side cost: flat, buy-and-hold at the adopted max position size, and 20-bar time-series momentum (long-short only when the combo is long-short).

rejectionRule.statistic: median-seed chained net result over the phase window
rejectionRule.rule: A combo is REJECTED if its median-seed net return is <= 0 or its median-seed max drawdown exceeds 20%. A median seed with zero round trips over the whole window is reported with reason no_trades: it is REJECTED because an inactive configuration demonstrates no edge (it is not evidence of a loss).

protocol.optimizerTrialLowerBoundSource: Combos on the production board (generatedAtMs 1791567076578); the true optimizer trial count is larger and unrecorded, so this lower bound under-deflates.
protocol.lifetimeCorrection: lifetimeAdjustedPsr = max(0, 1 - min(1, optimizerTrialLowerBound * (1 - PSR))) (Bonferroni, repo convention)

combos.windowBarsNote: params.bars=0 resolves to the Binance default of 500 bars in live

excludedCombos.reason: Symbol is in the sealed 1,227-return holdout universe through 2026-05-01 and in the cross_sectional_funding_carry_v1 prospective window through 2027-01-20T13:00Z; from 2027-01-21 the frozen champion is already a registered HAR-RV baseline.

snapshot.source: s3://<TRADER_STATE_S3_BUCKET>/trader-prod/optimizer/top-combos.json read 2026-10-09; the five pinned UUIDs only
snapshot.notCommitted: The repository is public; live parameters stay out of git. Each combo uuid is a SHA-256 of its params, thresholds, objective and source.

retrospective.lawfulness: UNI/SUI/ETC are outside every registered universe before 2027-01-21 (residual/funding, carry and sequential-screen universes exclude them; HAR-RV/OFI/missingness data start 2027-01-21).
retrospective.selectionBiasDisclosure: Rows before pinnedAtMs informed the 2026-08-26 pin decision, which biases this window upward; that only makes a REJECTED outcome more conservative. The post-pin subwindow is reported separately and is not a decision input.

prospective.beforeEvaluationPolicy: Only metadata (row counts, gaps, hashes) may be computed before minimumEvaluationTimeUtc. No return, PnL, position or statistic on any row in the window.
passGates: every combo NOT_REJECTED under the rejection rule
fleet net Sharpe above both buy-and-hold and momentum baselines
net return still > 0 with costs doubled and with a one-bar decision delay (stress implementation must be committed and tested on pre-createdAtMs data before startMs evidence is read)
prospective.powerDisclosure: About 600 4h / 400 6h bars. With the >=3261-trial lower bound the lifetime-adjusted gate requires PSR >= 0.99998 (z of about 4.2); a PASS is unlikely unless the edge is very large. A failed gate is a rejection, not a reason to extend the window.

trialAccounting: No new configuration is created: the five combos are frozen, already-selected optimizer outputs. Five seeds are reruns of the same configuration (median decides). This campaign is separate from the 46-trial residual/funding count.
forbiddenActions: opening or overlapping the sealed 1,227-return holdout
reading AVAX/ADA or any carry-universe returns before 2027-01-20T13:00Z
changing combos, seeds, windows, chunking or rules after any evaluation-window result
promoting, resizing or authorizing anything from this campaign without human review
